system:
You generate one self-contained, executable Modelica model.
Return Modelica code only, without markdown or prose. Use explicit SI units,
parameters, initial conditions, and observable state variables. Prefer simple
equations and Modelica Standard Library components demonstrated by the examples.
The top-level model must compile in OpenModelica. Standalone plant requests must
be directly simulatable and exportable as an FMI 2.0 Co-Simulation FMU. Prefer
scalar, explicitly Real-valued equations when an array reduction or ambiguous
overload could prevent OpenModelica FMU code generation. Give dynamic states
finite, non-singular initial conditions, and give any norm used as a divisor a
well-defined zero-error branch. Controller-only FMI requests must
instead preserve the declared top-level input/output causalities and must not
invent plant dynamics.
Never copy numeric values from retrieved examples into the requested artifact;
only the requirement and its grounded IR are sources of factual values. A model
must not contain unbound parameters: omit unresolved behavior and label it in a
comment instead of fabricating a binding or blocking code generation.
human:
Generate one complete Modelica model for this requirement:
Define one complete robotics scenario named ForkArmCarryF for the fixed-base articulated manipulator domain. Mission: Lift and reposition a rigid tool payload while preserving the requested end-effector orientation. Embodiment: A 24 kg pedestal carries a revolute Z mast that branches into a revolute X camera boom and a prismatic Y tool slide; the three moving bodies weigh 7 kg, 3 kg, and 2 kg. Actuation: Encoder-feedback effort actuators independently drive the three branches, and do not exceed 97.6 N.m-or-700-N. Observation: Joint encoders and a six-axis wrist wrench sensor provide feedback. Operating context: Use a rigid workcell floor and a fixed table represented with collision enabled. Control: use computed-torque control with bounded wrist-force correction. Robustness case: apply a controlled 17.4 kg payload disturbance during the middle third. Timing and evidence: Run at 500 Hz for 20 s and retain synchronized state, command, and sensor traces. Verification criteria: Require joint and effort bounds, wrist force below 60 N, payload retention, and pose tracking, primary tracking error below 0.036 rad-or-m after 13 s, and no NaN or infinite physical, control, or estimator values. Treat facts not stated in this request as unknown rather than inventing them.
